description:
Incorporated in 1983, Bhartiya International Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and trading of leather products and textile products. [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] BIL is a part of the Bhartiya Group. It is a fashion house that is engaged in the business of manufacturing and exporting leather outerwear, accessories, and apparel. The company operates through a multi-location setup with many manufacturing facilities. It caters primarily to international clients and develops fashion collections for 150 luxury brands /retailers across the world.
